thread:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Prospect (Greenfield Bank) POC failing intermittently when routing to our Private VPC via interface endpoints. Need quick presales triage.

lee_se: What failure mode? 5xx or connection errors?

maria_sales: They see 502s and timeouts under load. Direct peered test worked. Problem path uses PrivateLink endpoint + corporate firewall.

ana_netops: Typical culprits: SNAT concentration, ephemeral port exhaustion, or DNS resolving to AZ-local endpoint IPs and hitting ACLs.

infra_oncall: Confirm whether their edge NAT collapses many clients to one SNAT IP. If so, recommend per-AZ NAT or expand SNAT pool.

lee_se: Also note pricing: interface endpoints have per-hour + per-GB fees. Peering removes endpoint charges but may add cross-AZ transfer costs. Dedicated reserved capacity can lower unit cost for steady traffic.

maria_sales: Action items for Greenfield: 1) check SNAT behavior & ephemeral ports; 2) allow 1024-65535 from our endpoint IPs for the POC; 3) run tcpdump if problem persists. I'll send this checklist.

deploy-bot: privatelink-endpoint-change deployed by infra at 2025-10-02T09:12:00Z.

maria_sales: thanks team, will follow up with customer and update thread when they respond.
